_comment: Subagent model routing for pi-dynamic-workflows (the `piwf` profile).
every agent() call in a workflow resolves its model through one of these tiers,
so this file is what makes subagents run on a different model than the main one.
install.sh seeds this file only when it is absent (see the 'left alone' rule below),
so edits made via /workflows-models survive a reinstall. To reset, delete the file
Model specs are canonical provider/id (unambiguous; the bare form would resolve via
defaultProvider). Pin all three tiers to the same model to force every subagent onto it
regardless of the orchestrator's main model. /workflows-models edits interactively.
